tagline: Remember every student. Prepare every lesson.
taglineJaHint: 生徒を忘れない。次回を自動で準備。

calendar.title: Google Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Classes imported from your connected Google Calendar
calendar.syncNote: Connect Google to pull booked classes from your calendar into AyaNote.
calendar.syncNoteConnected: Use Sync now to refresh events from Google Calendar (past 30 days → next 60 days). Opening this page alone does not call Google.
calendar.emptyNeedConnect: Connect Google Calendar to see booked classes here.
calendar.emptySynced: No timed events found in the sync window. Add classes on Google Calendar, then Sync.

students.title: Students
students.subtitle: Profiles, timeline, and progress
students.name: Name
students.inviteHint: One-time magic link for student login (demo: opens student portal).

lessonRoom.title: Lesson Room
lessonRoom.subtitle: Meet transcript → summarize → save memory
lessonRoom.manualFallback: Paste the Meet transcript, then generate a summary. Drive fetch is preferred when available.
lessonRoom.driveHint: Looks for a Google Doc near this lesson’s end time (student name / 文字起こし / transcript).
lessonRoom.regenNote: A summary already exists — submitting will regenerate it.
lessonRoom.noExamples: No example sentences yet — regenerate with AI.
lessonRoom.aiMissing: AI key missing ({provider}) — local heuristic only
lessonRoom.okSummary: Summary generated. Review and approve below.
lessonRoom.warnNoAiKey: No AI API key on server — summary used a local heuristic. Set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for better results.
lessonRoom.errDriveNotFound: No matching Drive Doc found. Wait for Meet transcript, set folder ID in Settings, or paste manually.
lessonRoom.errDriveEmpty: Matched a Drive Doc but it was empty.
lessonRoom.errDriveNoGoogle: Google is not connected. Connect in Settings.

availability.title: Availability
availability.subtitle: Rules for student booking — 1 hour lessons, starts at :00 or :30

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Workspace defaults
settings.google: Connect Calendar + Drive to import booked classes, Meet links, and Meet transcripts from Drive.
settings.googleReady: OAuth credentials detected. Connect your Workspace account.
settings.googleMissingCreds: Set GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, and GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI (or NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL).
settings.googleConnectedBanner: Google connected. Calendar classes will sync automatically.
settings.driveExplain: After Meet “record transcript”, Google saves a Doc in Drive. AyaNote searches by student name and lesson end time. Optionally limit search to one folder (paste the folder ID from the Drive URL).
settings.stt: Primary capture: Drive auto-fetch (Lesson Room button or daily cron) + manual paste.
settings.privacy: Students see summaries only by default.

studentHome.title: Your lessons
studentHome.noUpcoming: No upcoming lesson synced yet. Ask your teacher to connect Google Calendar, or book a slot.
studentHome.noMeetYet: Meet link not on this calendar event yet.

studentBook.title: Book / Reschedule
studentBook.subtitle: Pick an open 1-hour slot — Ayano confirms
studentBook.slotHint: Lessons are 60 minutes. Blackouts and weekly limits apply.
studentBook.noSlots: No open slots in the next 2 weeks.
